title: Permissions, least privilege and human confirmation

videos.script: An agent that acts needs a boundary, and the boundary has to hold when the model is wrong. This lesson draws one, in code, for Marginalia's support agent. {{title}} This repository has drawn the same kind of boundary for the two people who run it. Three roles in a fixed order, a second factor checked at the door, and an audit that refuses an action with nobody against it. {{repo}} For the agent, a role is a list of tools. A tool that is not on the list is never offered, and a call to it is refused by the host, whatever the model asked for. {{roles}} A refund needs a person who sees the exact order and amount, and the server asks again on its own account. {{confirm}} A test article carries a harmless canary, a request to reply with one word, and the host's check holds back any reply that repeats it. {{canary}} And every decision, allowed or refused, is written down with the actor that made it. {{last}}
